description: A painted oil scene in a dim, rough stone room. A man in a dark suit, seen from the side with his head bowed, holds a earpiece to one ear with his hand. On a wooden table sit brass-terminal wireless boxes, coils, a glass tube component and loose wires, lit by an oil lamp. Through a window, a stormy grey sky with a small kite-like shape over dark hills. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
